notes: Partition verified: 30 units cover all 31 source (s024+s025 fused) and 44 target ids exactly once.

The clause-opening waw of `וּנְבֵלָה` carries the ASV's *for* under rule 14, so nothing here is `added`; the *even* before *till now* likewise answers to the waw of `וְעַד־עַתָּה`, and the waw of `וּטְרֵפָה` takes *or*.
The partitive *of* before *that which dieth* is placed with the rule 46 recast substantive rather than with the verb; the competing reading is named in that unit's note.

`וְלֹא` fuses to *neither* under rule 35, headed on the negative, with no answering *nor* written, so rule 14's correlative clause does not apply; *there* in *came there abominable flesh* is the pleonastic presentative that rule 17 keeps with the verb even though an explicit subject noun follows.
